task_description: Three agents collaborate to collect and synthesize information from multiple online sources to produce a comprehensive research report on the impact of climate change on marine biodiversity. The agents must search, retrieve, reconcile conflicting data, and compile the findings into a well-attributed, accurate report.
expected_outcome: The agents successfully gather accurate information, resolve any discrepancies, and produce a cohesive research report with proper source attribution.

agents.description: This agent searches for and retrieves relevant information from multiple online sources.
This agent analyzes the collected data, resolves conflicts, and prepares datasets for the report.
This agent synthesizes the analyzed data and generates the final research report with proper source attribution.
